notes: Haarlemmerweg 778-938 (BAG pand 0363100012250971, built 2023, 749 m2, eaves 36.5 m, 12 storeys at 3.0 m). HELD: every panorama of this tower is leafy. The archive holds every capture day the municipality has within 150 m (2017-04-24, 2019-01-07, 2019-04-15, 2019-11-07, 2022-01-25, 2022-04-08, 2022-12-06, 2024-09-09, 2024-11-21, 2024-11-26, 2025-07-01; artefacts of the all-walls.ts runs and the day inventory are in the lane report). The tower only exists from 2023, so the 2017/2019/2022 crops show the low 1980s office block it replaced and are not evidence. Of the post-completion days: 2025-07-01 (north 46 % foliage, west 37 %, east 53 %, return 63 %), 2024-09-09 (north 57 %, west 53 %, east 40 %), 2024-11-21 leaf-off but 86-88 m off, 49-55 deg oblique, washed out 0.28-0.88, and 2024-11-26 leaf-off at 45 m with 64 % of the crop classed as foliage. No street-facing wall has a usable crop (foliage > 25 % or > 45 deg oblique), so the likeness gate cannot judge this house and it is not installable. It is kept as a draft for a future panorama.

walls[0] = panel 7 (north, surface 10, 21.4 m): dark charcoal brick, a grid of wide windows with a narrow slot beside each (the same pair rhythm as Haarlemmerweg 940), deep recessed loggias with pale slab soffits stacked on the right third, and a glazed ground floor with the entrance on the paved square. walls[1] = panel 0 (west, surfaces 1 and 5, 29.8 m) and walls[2] = panels 2 and 4 (east, surfaces 3 and 4 plus the 9.8 m return 7) carry the same dark brick grid; walls[3] = panel 1 (south, surface 2, 21.8 m of which 9 m is party wall) has no photo. All four are drawn from the draft's reading of the 2025 north crop and from the 3DBAG massing; none of them is measured.

Not drawn, and the reason this house needs a bespoke pass before it can be accepted: the deep recessed loggia stacks (the kit projects balconies, it cannot recess one, so the loggias read as punched windows and piers) and the cantilevered white crown. The south group's projecting balconies sit in bays 1, 3 and 5 (every second bay from the second): in the end bays their 1.2 m slabs and glass rails reached past the panel silhouette (audit opening-outside 2 parts, 3.74 m2). Triangle budget 14,000 (intent `budgetTriangles`) keeps the 12-storey grid inside a gate.
